name: Booking+
description: Companion to the Booking plugin — per-service extras for practitioners: preparation-page + WhatsApp links, automatic post-booking response, per-service min-advance-days gate (HSR-style delays), prerequisite-service gate (e.g. requires a prior Discovery Call), a client-facing 'human message' step routed to the practitioner, an 8-hour internal nudge if no reply, and manual/fallback Zoom link handling. Seeds the multi-tier reminder cadence (8 days / day before / 10 minutes) on activate.
author: Slate

permissions.label: Configure per-service extras and global Booking+ settings
View and reply to client 'human message' threads
